about_short_description.short_description: Turing College is an online tech school for AI & Data skills, backed by Ycombinator.

product.name: Data Science & AI Program
product.description: A program designed to teach students data science and AI skills through real-life projects, including machine learning and deep learning, with mentorship from industry experts.

product.name: Data Analytics Program
product.description: This program focuses on teaching data analytics through practical projects in areas like product analytics and marketing analytics, using tools like SQL and Python.

product.name: Web Development Program
product.description: A comprehensive program that teaches front-end and back-end web development, including languages and tools like HTML, CSS, JS, Python, and React, through project-based learning.

product.name: Digital Marketing & Analytics Program
product.description: Designed for those looking to enter digital marketing, this program covers user acquisition, partnership marketing, and marketing analytics, with a focus on AI tools.

product.name: Data Engineering Program
product.description: Focuses on teaching data engineering skills, including Python, SQL, and data pipeline management, through hands-on projects and real-world scenarios.

identifier.value: Master's Degree in Data Science & Analytics

product.name: Master's Degree in Data Science & Analytics
product.description: An EU-accredited Master's degree program offering advanced study in data science and analytics, including a thesis project guided by industry professionals.
